pipeline_params.description: AINative Router: task-group routing policy (per-cell model assignment + lambda sweep on Arena Score) fit only on a 2,179-query external calibration set built from the same public source benchmarks with all RouterArena items removed (exact, template-stripped MiniLM >=0.85, and source-ID checks). v2 adds deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 to the pool; accepted on a fresh 2,177-query held-out calibration extension (same construction, disjoint from RouterArena and from the fit set). Policy/signals hash-frozen before routing RouterArena. Per-row provenance (requested_model, model_used, provider, request_id, invoked_at) recorded.
